note_text: Routine inspection passed. All weld seams within tolerance. No defect clusters observed.
Minor cosmetic blemish on batch BT-4412 housing, within acceptable limits. Passed QC.
Standard calibration check on M-07 completed. Drift within normal range (0.3%). All units passed.
Full batch inspection of Model-B run. Zero defects detected. Excellent weld consistency.
Noticed slight misalignment on housing seam welds for Model-A units. M-07 calibration drift may be starting to affect output. Flagged for maintenance review.

Defect clustering on housing seam weld is getting worse this week. Almost 1 in 5 units failing first-pass QC. M-07 drift observed again this shift — technician Rodriguez confirmed drift at 2.1% which is above our 1.0% action threshold.

Line 3 yield continues to deteriorate. Housing seam weld failures now account for 60% of all rejects. M-07 calibration drift is clearly the root cause — drift reading at 3.4% as of this morning. Recommend emergency recalibration.
Worst week yet for Line 3. First-pass yield dropped below 80%. All failures trace back to M-07 weld station. Drift now at 4.1%. Production manager escalated to plant director.

M-07 drift measured at 4.8%. Emergency recalibration request submitted but waiting on parts. Meanwhile, secondary visual inspection checkpoint added after M-07 station to catch defects before final assembly.
Line 2 running smoothly. All machines within calibration spec. Yield steady at 96.5%.
Southeast Plant Line 3 is fine — yield at 95.8%. No calibration issues. This is only a Midwest Plant problem.

Received a batch from SUP-03 with lower material quality score than usual. However, the defect pattern on Line 3 is clearly mechanical (weld seam) not material (no surface cracking or brittleness). M-07 drift remains the primary issue.
Line 1 continues excellent performance. Same SUP-03 material batch used here with zero quality issues, confirming the problem is machine-specific, not material-specific.
All Southeast lines performing within expected parameters. No yield deviation observed.
